rows.name: type
rows.description: the Sorting Type of the Cell.

rows.name: alignment
rows.description: controls the alignment of the content of the Cell.

rows.name: showSortIndicator
rows.description: controls the sortable state of the Cell. If this value is true, then the Cell can be interacted with.

rows.name: onSort
rows.description: Pass the action to be performed on click of sortIndicator.

rows.name: sortableIcon
rows.description: Icon to be displayed when showSortIndicator is set to true. If nothing is set the default icon logic will be used.
